calculation_policy: No min/max/mean/max-min recomputation. Official DEM/LIDAR tile evidence is accepted only after canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel binding.
first_missing_criterion: BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel identifiers/geometries (or explicit missing DEM/LIDAR tile ids/bboxes) from local OpenCode
next_modified_method: Use a local BUILDING_PRESENT selector (canonical parcel geometry/bbox or exact missing tile id), then query only intersecting official DTM Time Stamped Extents features (<=50) and retain tile id, CRS, spacing/resolution evidence, dates and transform/geoid metadata. Do not compute parcel elevation statistics remotely.
